name: Japan to go, please!
source:
Hello viewers, it's me again! Tally from Travel to go please! Accompany me on my journey through Japan. There I not only meet friendly [s]Yokai[/s] natives but also take part in a competition.

[Edited from [url=https://lichtel.itch.io/japan-to-go-please]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
各位观众大家好，又是我！请从旅行中理货吧！陪伴我踏上日本之旅。在那里我不仅遇到了友好的[s]Yokai[/s]当地人，还参加了比赛。

[编辑自[url=https://lichtel.itch.io/japan-to-go-please]itch.io[/url]]
